about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_github_file.py). bad replays the github get_file_contents class of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Failed to get file contents line. good lists the directory or the repo record first, verifies the path, fetches only the verified file, then prints the verified report it promises.

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents for guessed nested path in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath content.txt -Raw; 'list verify PASS directory file'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents fetching one file by guess in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath content.txt -Raw; 'list verify PASS fetch file'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents rerunning the same guessed path in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; 'single stop PASS verify list'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents after fetching by guess in owner/name'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath content.txt -Raw; 'record verify PASS single fetch'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents reading chained guesses in owner/name'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; 'record single PASS fetch path'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents on an uncertain path in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; 'directory verify PASS file verdict'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents for a directory path in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; 'directory listing PASS fallback file'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents with no fallback listing in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; 'stop listing PASS report miss'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents for a branch-qualified guessed path in owner/name'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath content.txt -Raw; 'branch verify PASS fetch pair'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents with the miss left silent in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; 'report RESULT PASS verified path'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents with no run record in owner/name'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; $c = Get-Content -LiteralPath content.txt -Raw; 'record RESULT PASS listing fetch'

pairs.bad: throw 'Failed to get file contents fetching a branch file by guess in owner/name'
pairs.good: $r = Get-Content -LiteralPath record.txt -Raw; 'branch record PASS verify path'
